The *Utena Sutta* (Ud 7.10; PTS Ud 79) is the concluding discourse of the seventh chapter of the *Udāna* in the Khuddaka Nikāya. The narrative centers on an incident in which five hundred awakened women die in a fire. Within later canonical and paracanonical exegesis, the sutta is referenced in the *Paññattihāravibhaṅga* of the *Nettippakaraṇa* (Ne 14).
